## Description

Combines rough path signature tensor embeddings with multivariate Hawkes jump-diffusion point processes to model non-linear path-dependent spread dynamics and jump arrivals in cointegrated asset pairs.

## Where it may fit

Statistical arbitrage with sudden spread jumps, high-frequency cointegration spread trading under volatility bursts.

## Vehicles

Statistical Arbitrage Hedge Funds, HFT Quantitative Desks.

## Required data

High-frequency tick or bar price series of paired assets, trade timestamps, quote cancellation logs.

## Caveats

Requires GPU acceleration for signature tensor transformations and Hawkes intensity kernel updates.
